assets.name: armsMotion
torsoForMotion
assets.prompt: Edit only the bare WORKING upper arm on the viewer's LEFT of this torso. Remove the left bare skin/biceps below the rolled green sleeve, making that area fully transparent. KEEP the green rolled sleeve intact as an opening where a complete arm animation will attach. Keep exactly unchanged the rest of the torso, right bare arm, hoodie, neck, strings, cut lines, scale, position and 1100x700 canvas. Do not fill the removed left arm with clothing and do not shorten the hoodie. The torso should have a clean left green sleeve opening with alpha immediately below it. Match the reference's hand-drawn 2D comic poster style: thick dark brown #3B1D14 outlines, thinner sparse anatomy lines, warm golden ochre skin, flat fills, two crisp shadow tones and small cream highlights, top/front light. No gradients, 3D, realistic pores, text, watermark, checkerboard or cast shadow. True alpha transparency.
